notes.title: Digital Deluxe Content Released!
notes.content:
The KNIGHTS and MERCHANTS DIGITAL DELUXE CONTENT includes: 

The Art of Knights and Merchants consisting of
- Digital Artbook (36 pages)
- Two Maps and Full-HD Wallpaper
- Poster Art
- Sliding Puzzle Game (Windows only)
- Cheats [English and German]
- Official Soundtrack with 33 atmospherical tracks
